nodes.description: Address with privileged control over minting, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances updated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances, decremented with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Maximum number of sale transfers allowed per address, checked in condition().
Minimum sale amount, checked in condition().
Maximum sale amount, checked in condition().
Counter of sale transfers per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Whitelist mapping set by _mints that bypasses the sale condition in ensure().
Privileged address that bypasses the sale condition in ensure().
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used for scaling amounts in _mints, init and constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address used as a whitelisted from-address in ensure().
Payable public transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance/balance bookkeeping with raw arithmetic and calling ensure().
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress and canSale, then enforces condition().
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view that enforces sale count and min/max sale limits from state variables.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-supplied data.
Mint/whitelist function restricted to owner or four hardcoded addresses, sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length and looping over recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass address.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure().
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and an unlimited UNI allowance.
Private helper performing a low-level call to an external token contract and decoding the result.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance ownership and transfer origin.
Raw unchecked subtraction of the sender balance inside transferFrom.
Raw unchecked addition of the recipient balance inside transferFrom.
Raw unchecked allowance decrement inside transferFrom.
Raw unchecked subtraction of the batch total from the caller balance.
Raw unchecked multiplication that can overflow the computed batch total.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an owner-supplied address and data payload.
Low-level external call to a token contract that can trigger callbacks into this contract.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Target contract address parameter of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate.
Array of recipient addresses for batchSend.
Address receiving minted balance in _mints.
Minted amount parameter of _mints.
Sale count parameter of init.
Minimum sale amount parameter of init.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init.
Local variable in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the _from account and as the allowance owner inside transferFrom.
transfer forwards all arguments to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist branch matches.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with raw multiplication.
batchSend deducts the unchecked total from balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend adds _value to each balanceOf[_to] inside the loop without SafeMath.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall guarded only by a msg.sender==owner check.
callOptionalReturn executes a low-level call to an untrusted token contract, enabling reentrant callbacks.
_from parameter feeds the balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the recipient of the balance addition in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives all arithmetic inside transferFrom.
target address a of the delegatecall is fully caller-controlled.
calldata b of the delegatecall is fully caller-controlled.
_tos array controls the batchSend loop and total computation.
_value multiplies the recipient count to form the batch total.
spender is the account credited in _mints and added to canSale.
addedValue is scaled by decimals and written to balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
saleNum is stored in _saleNum by init.
token scales into _minSale by init.
maxToken scales into _maxSale by init.
the local total computed from an unchecked multiplication is deducted from the caller balance.
msg.sender is checked against owner to authorise the delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner to run batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to run init.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
msg.sender is compared to owner and four hardcoded minter addresses in _mints.
constructor stores msg.sender as owner and credits the initial supply.
owner state variable is the sole authorisation for the delegatecall.
owner state variable gates the batchSend entry point.
owner state variable gates the _mints entry point.
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
allowance mapping is read and decremented by transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
_saleNum is read by condition to limit transfers.
_minSale is read by condition to enforce a minimum amount.
_maxSale is read by condition to enforce a maximum amount.
_onSaleNum is read by condition to compare against _saleNum.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented by transferFrom.
canSale[_from] whitelist entry bypasses condition inside ensure.
tradeAddress equality bypasses condition inside ensure.
totalSupply is initialised in the constructor.
decimals scales addedValue in _mints.
decimals scales token and maxToken in init.
the UNI constant is a whitelisted _from bypass in ensure.
pairFor derives the Uniswap pair address compared against _from in ensure.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only consumed by the balance and allowance updates of transferFrom.
_to is only consumed by the recipient balance update of transferFrom.
_value is only used in the unchecked arithmetic of transferFrom.
a is only used as the delegatecall target in delegate.
b is only used as the delegatecall payload in delegate.
_tos is only iterated over inside batchSend.
spender is only used to set balanceOf and canSale in _mints.
addedValue is only used to set the minted balance in _mints.
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init.
token is only stored into _minSale by init.
maxToken is only stored into _maxSale by init.
total is a loop-scoped local of batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length.
